name: Infernal Guardian

abilities.name: Double Slam
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does moderate physical damage. If taunted the boss will be forced to use this attack on the tank only.

abilities.name: Thorny Backhand
abilities.description: The boss slaps the target, dealing moderate physical damage and inflicting Bleeding, which is a minor physical damage over time.

abilities.name: Ground Slam
abilities.description: The boss slams the ground, dealing moderate physical damage around itself as indicated by a red circle. This also staggers all enemies within.

abilities.name: Fiery Explosion
abilities.description: The boss spews fire in front of itself as indicated by red circles. This does high flame damage and should be avoided by standing behind the boss.

abilities.name: Consuming Fire
abilities.description: While casting Fiery Explosion, the boss will deal minor flame damage around itself.

abilities.name: Tunneling Roots
abilities.description: The boss stomps sending roots to hit a player far away from it. This deals moderate physical damage and staggers the target.

related_quests: Razor's Edge: Drive back the Daedra from a burning Bosmeri city.
Pledge: City of Ash I: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing the City of Ash I.
City of Ash Pledge: Explore the City of Ash and return Undaunted. (disabled since Patch 2.6.4)
summary: This article is about the creature. For the item set, see Infernal Guardian (set). The Infernal Guardian is a burning Lurcher encountered in the City of Ash I, where it serves as a boss. The Infernal Guardian Monster Helm Set is named after it, although it doesn't drop any pieces. It does, however, have a chance to drop a unique item named Wildmaul.
